title: Bound Planning archive growth through retention, distillation, and compact receipts

intent.outcome: Planning closes work into compact, queryable Git receipts and can incrementally export and remove bulky retained archives with exact loss accounting, while enforcing host growth budgets.
non_goals: Delete the repository's existing archive in this feature branch.
Move full archive history into another checked-in directory.
Treat dry-run as a sandbox or silently discard unresolved intent.

owned: packages/planning archive lifecycle and public command projection
Planning retention schemas, docs, fixtures, and generated command surfaces
effects: A caller may explicitly export and replace retained full archives with compact receipts; dry-run remains the default inspection path.

delegation.reason: User requested continuous implementation without authorizing subagents; archive lifecycle, command projection, and proof are one tightly coupled slice.

next_action: Implement branch-safe archive compaction, exact dry-run loss accounting, compact receipt lookup, and bounded-growth proof.

claims: Bound Planning archive growth through retention, distillation, and compact receipts is implemented, validated, and closed out honestly.
